name: Aqua
source:
About 13 years old.
Affiliation: Magic Institute
Hobby: Cooking (She's no good though)
Special Skill: Finding People's Weaknesses
Likes: Things to Help Her Sleep
Dislikes: Noisy Things

A quite and unsociable girl who has lost her memories, also a Star Maiden candidate.
She's skilled with magic and can easily understand things in an instant to a degree.
She has a bit of a bad mouth.
